recipes.name: ffmpeg
recipes.summary: Converts, merges and inspects audio and video. yt-dlp needs it to merge separate streams; players use it to transcode.

recipes.name: slskd
recipes.summary: Soulseek client with a web UI and HTTP API. Music apps use it to search and download from the Soulseek network.

recipes.name: yt-dlp
recipes.summary: Downloads audio and video from YouTube and hundreds of other sites. Music apps use it to fetch tracks and streams.
